project.purpose: Bind the source-implemented task-local LEGO contracts and verifier/consumer seams to the existing Git-backed graph without turning Composition into another execution, proof or domain authority.

nodes.label: CircuitManifestAndGateContract
nodes.responsibility: Validate and deterministically compile a bounded typed DAG manifest; qualify exact verifier-owned gate evidence without claiming domain completion.
nodes.authority: Composition source contract only, verifier/domain semantic authority remains outside
inputs: typed circuit manifest, node/gate edges and declared assumptions
gate-result report and immutable manifest digest
outputs: validated deterministic compiled manifest or CircuitContractError
mechanical gate standing distinct from semantic domain acceptance
nodes.behavioralContract: Manifest has unique typed references, excludes illegal dependency cycles and unresolved assumptions, and rejects mismatched or stale verifier-owned gate evidence; mechanical closure never invents successful domain effects.
acceptance: Contract fixtures check deterministic compilation, stale result rejection, unknown assumptions and malformed/cyclic graph behavior.
formalObligations: Nonvacuous contract satisfaction and full model-to-real-execution refinement are not established by DAG validity.

nodes.label: InterfaceCompatibilityAndAdmissibility
nodes.responsibility: Evaluate explicitly declared interface compatibility, provenance and evidence currentness independently of provider execution.
nodes.authority: Composition source contract only, verifier/domain semantic authority remains outside
inputs: typed provider/consumer interface declaration and mapping
effect/authority scopes and qualified evidence observation
outputs: compatibility, admission and currentness standing with grounded reasons
nodes.behavioralContract: Output distinguishes compatibility, evidence sufficiency and currentness; missing, unknown or stale source does not become proof of actual deployment compatibility.
acceptance: Negative tests reject circuit binding mismatch and ambiguous/stale evidence while preserving distinct compatibility/currentness status.
formalObligations: Source-verified compatibility result is not assume-guarantee fulfillment by actual Runtime/Host consumers.

nodes.label: GateProofObligationProjection
nodes.responsibility: Project declared Composition gates and accepted exact verifier bindings into deterministic task-local proof obligations without discovering or executing verifiers.
nodes.authority: Composition source contract only, verifier/domain semantic authority remains outside
inputs: validated compiled manifest, gate requirements and verifier binding declarations
outputs: bounded exact verifier bindings or qualified contract errors
nodes.behavioralContract: Obligation identities and source commitments preserve exact manifest/gate scope; a caller cannot claim an arbitrary matching verifier or unsupported goal as accepted evidence.
acceptance: Verification obligation suites reject cross-circuit bindings, malformed identities and unauthorized inferred completeness.
formalObligations: Source-to-verifier correctness, checker soundness and psi=>phi entailment remain proof obligations.

nodes.label: SelectiveProofImpact
nodes.responsibility: Compare exact bounded SourceCut/contract/proof/assumption changes and propagate typed proof impact while preserving UNKNOWN and conditional reuse standing.
nodes.authority: Composition source contract only, verifier/domain semantic authority remains outside
inputs: prior/current scoped graph, proof dependencies, source deltas and external assumption inputs
outputs: RECHECK_REQUIRED, UNKNOWN, or non-authoritative REUSE_CANDIDATE by affected gate/obligation
nodes.behavioralContract: Real changed paths/declared negative dependencies must not disappear from effective inputs; cyclic/unknown dependencies fail closed and candidate reuse is never final proof admissibility.
acceptance: Existing graph/impact tests check unindexed source, dynamic edges, relation membership, cycles and independent impact oracle.
formalObligations: Actual dynamic consumers, installation/environment closure and downstream proof acceptance remain UNKNOWN.

Model-level impact transport conservativeness: for every declared row r, compact membership is equivalent to original membership AND standing(r) != NO_DECLARED_HIT. This is checked by the Lean kernel in tools/formal/RecursiveLegoRefinement.lean (compact_iff_non_nohit), not a Composition/Python implementation refinement.
UNKNOWN and any newly encountered non-NO_DECLARED_HIT status must be preserved by compact transport (Lean compact_keeps_unknown and compact_keeps_arbitrary_future_standing).

NO_DECLARED_HIT does not imply unchanged dynamic consumers, environmental assumptions, or admissible proof reuse; Lean no_declared_hit_does_not_imply_no_external_change proves a counterexample. Composition selection semantics and Repo transport still require an explicit model-to-source implementation bridge and qualified actual consumer/readset.
nodes.qualification: SOURCE_CONTRACT_IMPLEMENTED; Lean formal verification covers conservative list-projection MODEL ONLY, not C04 implementation refinement, installed/consumer/domain acceptance

nodes.label: SuccessorGateAndReplacementContract
nodes.responsibility: Bind exact predecessor/candidate transitions to verifier-owned required gates without claiming global optimality or authorization to promote.
nodes.authority: Composition source contract only, verifier/domain semantic authority remains outside
inputs: declared change targets, required verifier gates and exact observations
nodes.behavioralContract: Missing, unresolved, stale, self-referential or optional-only gates cannot vacuously satisfy a required successor transition.
acceptance: Tests verify required positive gates, optional-only nonvacuity, self-reference and unknown/negative gate handling.
formalObligations: Candidate implementation contextual equivalence and external domain acceptance need separate consumer-owned evidence.

nodes.label: ScopedExternalEffectReconciliation
nodes.responsibility: Constrain a task-local external execution outcome to owner-native observation/reconciliation/domain-effect readbacks and conservatively invalidate only declared dependent proof obligations.
nodes.authority: Composition task-local read-only adapter; Gateway/Runtime remain execution truth and actual domain owner retains external-effect and retry authorization
inputs: Gateway ExecutionObservation-shaped record with exact operationRef/nativeId/ownerId
expected exact operationRef and current task-local proof dependency graph
outputs: OBSERVE_ORIGINAL_OPERATION, RECONCILE_ORIGINAL_OPERATION or VERIFY_DOMAIN_EFFECT_WITH_OWNER readback recommendation
scoped unknown effect reference with existing C04 proof impact projection; malformed inputs produce CircuitContractError
nodes.behavioralContract: Never retries, dispatches, grants permission or certifies an external provider effect. Runtime executionTerminal=true, exitCode=0 and deliveryDisposition=committed still require provider-owned effect confirmation. Missing unindexed effect references broaden UNKNOWN through C04 instead of producing an empty impact.
acceptance: tests/test_effect_reconciliation_r1.py verifies Gateway external.pull started lease expiry, runtime-terminal committed-but-effect-unknown, unrelated proof isolation and absent dynamic effect UNKNOWN.
Rejects forged native operation identity, false-like JSON terminality/recovery values and malformed caller inputs; CLI preserves same negative behavior.
mustNotOwn: Gateway/Rust Runtime physical attempt state or Job dispatch
provider-side effect receipt and durable idempotency/compensation authority
automatic retry, release, deployment, domain acceptance or formal proof admission

consumerBindings.operation: source import and python -m CLI against Gateway-shaped scenario fixtures

formalObligations: A task-local Gateway-shaped JSON record is not an authenticated native owner readback and must not grant effect/retry permission.
Effect dependency closure is caller declared; a hidden provider read remains UNKNOWN, and source/test evidence cannot prove execution exactly once.

edges.label: exact circuit digest/manifest supplies input for interface checks
source-bound manifest and exact gate scope support impact analysis
proof obligation references and dependencies support invalidation
exact predecessor/candidate circuit gates require bound evidence
existing selective proof obligation impact supplies scoped UNKNOWN propagation to effect reconciliation

knownGaps: Confirmed imports from meta/next at Git SourceCut; runtime installation and external consumers not attested.
Refinement from formal verifier target psi to domain target phi not inferred from source-only contract projection.
Cross-owner dynamic calls and provider native effects remain UNKNOWN outside these local source contracts.
C06 consumes only Gateway-shaped, caller supplied observations; no owner-authenticated provider completion receipt or live/installed consumer qualification.
